# Orientation — the 10-minute tour

ticketd is the internal ticket tracker: one Flask file, three SQLite tables, seven routes,
running since 2019. Tickets are created open, listed by everyone (62% of all traffic is
the list route), and closed once — closing emails the watchers, and doing that
synchronously over SMTP inside the request is the defect that finally bought this rewrite
(PB-001: the June outage stopped ticket-closing for 40 minutes). The rewrite rebuilds it
whole on FastAPI + Postgres with a clean cutover, changing exactly three sanctioned
things — synchronous mail (PB-001), MD5-cleartext reset tokens (PB-002), slug collisions
(PB-003, fix pending ruling OQ-001) — and freezing everything else, including the quirks
that look like bugs but hold the UI up (the 200-`{}` missing-ticket response, no
pagination).

- Legacy pinned at `be1032b5d3a2` (sha-recorded-clone)
- Evidence subsystems: runtime_ingestion=active, data_census=inactive, trace_capture_t1=inactive
